statusText: EA_ON / green: available Sunday-evening reporting remains near flat, and no verified current evidence shows persistent NQ mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is below the WATCH threshold; headline and oil-driven Stress remain extreme while granular live NQ retracement evidence is incomplete.
headline: Near-flat reopening tone keeps Tail below WATCH while oil and geopolitical stress remain extreme
body: Sunday Globex is open. Barron's reported Nasdaq-100 futures about 0.1% higher at the reopening, while Reuters reported WTI near $101 after Houthi attacks on Riyadh. No fresher granular NQ pullback or repeated-extension sequence was verified by the cutoff, and no verified outcome from the U.S.-China talks was available.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 UTC hours were green / EA_ON with Tail 15-19% through 21:00 UTC, moved to WATCH at 23% at the 22:00 UTC reopening, and eased to 20% at 23:00 UTC as available futures reporting remained close to flat.
outlookSummary: Tail is below WATCH in the current hour because available reopening evidence does not show persistent one-way structure. The main conditional risk window is the Monday U.S. cash-open transition, with WATCH around 12:00-15:00 UTC and a smaller late-session checkpoint around 19:00 UTC.

forecast.analysis: Available Sunday-evening reporting has Nasdaq-100 futures roughly 0.1% higher after reopening, while no fresher granular NQ pullback/extension feed was verified by the cutoff. That is insufficient evidence of persistent one-way structure, so Tail is below WATCH.
drivers: No verified granular NQ retracement sequence
WTI near $101 keeps inflation stress elevated
U.S.-China talks have no verified outcome at cutoff

forecast.analysis: At 01:00 UTC, low Tail is conditional on two-way overnight price discovery. A fresh directional break with shallow pullbacks or repeated failed retracements would invalidate the normalization even if headline flow itself is unchanged.
drivers: Oil and geopolitical headline risk remain active

forecast.analysis: Thin overnight liquidity can amplify isolated moves, but Tail stays low if price continues to rotate rather than hold a directional extreme. Cross-asset confirmation would be required to turn generic overnight volatility into stronger Tail evidence.
drivers: Cross-asset confirmation required for higher Tail

forecast.analysis: Low Tail remains conditional on orderly overnight trade. A sustained directional move that repeatedly rejects retracements would matter more than the absolute size of a single headline-driven swing.
drivers: Headline swings alone do not establish Tail

forecast.analysis: Into the late U.S. evening, the base case remains rotational. Persistent movement near the overnight extreme with shallow pullbacks would be the principal structure capable of lifting Tail materially.
drivers: Shallow pullbacks would challenge the base case

forecast.analysis: Early Asia hours remain low-Tail in the base case if the Sunday reopening impulse has stabilized. Stress stays high because oil and geopolitical developments can still reprice rates and equities quickly.
drivers: Stability after the Sunday reopening impulse

forecast.analysis: The base case remains normal if Asian trading absorbs the reopening headlines without persistent extension. A renewed one-way move aligned with rates, oil or technology leadership would increase Tail evidence.
drivers: Persistent extension would invalidate normal mode

forecast.analysis: Europe's approach can introduce fresh cross-asset information, but Tail stays low unless NQ begins to extend repeatedly with limited retracement. Generic volatility alone remains a Stress input.
drivers: Volatility without path persistence remains Stress

forecast.analysis: European price discovery is a conditional checkpoint for whether overnight moves broaden or retrace. Low Tail assumes no sustained NQ extreme-holding and no strong cross-asset reinforcement.

U.S. premarket participation begins to build. Tail stays just below WATCH unless the overnight direction survives fresh liquidity with shallow pullbacks; scheduled Fed communication is a Stress checkpoint, not automatic Tail evidence.
drivers: Fed communication can raise Stress without path confirmation

forecast.analysis: Ahead of heavier U.S. participation, Tail remains below WATCH if overnight gains or losses continue to retrace meaningfully. A clean premarket directional build without retracement would challenge that base case.
drivers: Directional build without retracement would lift Tail

forecast.analysis: The hour before the U.S. cash-open transition carries rising execution stress, but Tail stays low unless premarket price action develops repeated extensions or holds close to an extreme across fresh liquidity.
drivers: Premarket extreme holding would lift Tail

forecast.analysis: Tail reaches WATCH as the U.S. cash-open transition approaches. This is a conditional checkpoint: escalation requires observed directional efficiency, shallow pullbacks or aligned cross-asset reinforcement rather than the clock alone.
drivers: Cross-asset reinforcement required for stronger Tail

forecast.analysis: The opening-auction hour is the peak conditional Tail window. A one-way move that holds near an extreme and rejects meaningful pullbacks would support escalation; two-way discovery and retracements would instead argue for rapid normalization.
drivers: Two-way discovery would lower Tail quickly
Oil and rates can amplify directional alignment

forecast.analysis: WATCH persists through the first full cash-session hour because opening moves can extend after failed retracements. Tail remains below the block threshold unless continuation becomes persistent and independently reinforced.
drivers: Independent reinforcement required for block-level Tail

forecast.analysis: Tail eases toward the lower WATCH boundary if the opening move has produced meaningful retracements. Continued extension after failed pullbacks would invalidate that decay and keep the earlier danger window active.

The base case moves below WATCH if the cash session has established two-way trade and retracements. A session-extreme hold with renewed extension would be the principal reason for Tail to remain elevated instead.
drivers: Renewed extension would prevent Tail decay

forecast.analysis: Mid-session Tail is low in the base case if earlier price discovery has remained rotational. A renewed directional impulse that erases prior retracements would be more important than headline intensity alone.
drivers: Renewed impulse must be observed to lift Tail

forecast.analysis: Normal mode is conditional on stable cross-assets and a cash session that has not developed persistent one-way structure. Oil remains a background stress amplifier rather than direct evidence of NQ Tail behavior.
drivers: Oil is a Stress amplifier, not standalone Tail proof

forecast.analysis: Power hour returns Tail to WATCH because late-session continuation can become efficient quickly. Escalation remains conditional on observed extreme holding, shallow pullbacks or repeated extension rather than time-of-day alone.
drivers: Extreme holding or shallow pullbacks required for escalation

forecast.analysis: After the cash close, Tail falls below WATCH in the base case if late-session movement has not remained one-way. Overnight headline sensitivity persists, but it primarily affects Stress without price-path confirmation.

The evening base case assumes no unresolved directional second leg from the cash session. Fresh geopolitical or oil shocks could raise Stress rapidly, while Tail would require corresponding persistent NQ structure.
drivers: No unresolved directional second leg assumed
Persistent NQ structure required for higher Tail

forecast.analysis: The next Globex evening remains low-Tail if Monday's session ended with retracements and no persistent extreme holding. A new overnight gap would reset the structure assessment rather than inherit Monday's base case mechanically.
drivers: Prior-session structure is not assumed to persist

forecast.analysis: Normal mode remains the late-evening base case if no new gap, directional second leg or cross-asset shock develops. Any fresh one-way structure would require a new evidence-based reassessment.
drivers: No new directional second leg assumed
